title: Megalithic architecture on Mars seen by remote viewers

tellings.quote: architecture what McMmonle and Swan saw on Mars was a style of architecture that matches the most titanic megalithic structures on Earth

plain: Two remote viewers, Joe McMoneagle and Ingo Swann (men said to see distant places by mind alone), saw buildings on Mars in a style that matches the most "titanic megalithic structures on Earth", the giant ancient stone works. The philosopher Jason Jorjani relays this on the show, also citing a man named Karl Wolfe. If true, it would suggest a link between builders on Mars and on Earth.
